span_text: [source_id: src.cyberchair_access_control_intent.authorization_intent_covered.p0003.l9] Authors can submit abstracts/papers during step 1.
[source_id: src.cyberchair_access_control_intent.authorization_intent_covered.p0004.l10] 2. Authors with step-2 credentials can upload full papers during step 2.
[source_id: src.cyberchair_access_control_intent.authorization_intent_covered.p0005.l11] Authors can correct step-1 submission information during step 2.
[source_id: src.cyberchair_access_control_intent.authorization_intent_covered.p0006.l12] Authors of selected submissions can submit camera-ready papers after review.

[source_id: src.cyberchair_access_control_intent.authorization_intent_covered.p0007.l13] "Assigned reviewers can access/download assigned papers after paper distribution, unless they have declared a conflict of interest."
[source_id: src.cyberchair_access_control_intent.authorization_intent_covered.p0008.l15] Assigned non-conflicted reviewers can submit or update reviews while review is open.
[source_id: src.cyberchair_access_control_intent.authorization_intent_covered.p0008.l15] Assigned non-conflicted reviewers can submit or update reviews while review is open.
[source_id: src.cyberchair_access_control_intent.authorization_intent_covered.p0009.l16] Reviewers can read other reviewers' reviews for a paper only after submitting their own review for that paper.
[source_id: src.cyberchair_access_control_intent.authorization_intent_covered.p0010.l18] Reviewers can declare conflicts of interest for assigned papers.

[source_id: src.cyberchair_access_control_intent.authorization_intent_covered.p0011.l19] Reviewers may volunteer for papers with conflicting reviews only after they have submitted all assigned reviews and are not conflicted with the paper.
[source_id: src.cyberchair_access_control_intent.authorization_intent_covered.p0012.l21] 10. Chairs/PCC can monitor the review process and identify low-expertise papers.
[source_id: src.cyberchair_access_control_intent.authorization_intent_covered.p0013.l22] 11. PCC can ask an additional reviewer to review a low-expertise paper.
[source_id: src.cyberchair_access_control_intent.authorization_intent_covered.p0014.l23] Reviewer directories and review files are protected from outsiders by per-directory allowed-user lists.
